body: `get_project_setting` seems to return a Variant but the new code assumes it can be safely used as String (and stores it directly in one on a variable that specifies it's a variant). The original code didn't make this assumption and it checked for the type as well.
That seems good to me, I wasn't clear if it was intentional or not as the name of the variable didn't change.
Oh I thought `driver_variant` meant "the variant/flavor of driver", not referred to the Variant type. I can rename it to just `driver` then.
I assigned the setting directly to `shader_container_driver` in the end, the intermediary variable didn't seem necessary.
